4331-4993-5116-8346.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Type-03 Borg Vessel.
If Type-03 Borg Vessel has at least seven charge counters on it, it triggers, creating a 1/1 colorless Borg artifact creature token.
Repeat.

240-4742-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-4742-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4556-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4556-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3488-3899-4552-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-3488-3899-4552-7803.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Katsumasa
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

565-1858-7753--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-7753--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-6593-7704.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Doc Samson.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-6593-7704.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-1126-6972.easyPrerequisites: There is a black card in your graveyard.
978-1126-6972.description:
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it.
When Xiahou Dun dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.
978-1126-6972.notes: To do this infinitely, don't resolve Xiahou Dun's ability and target the same card each loop.

206-1563-2457-4321.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a Food token and a creature token.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

5147-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5147-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token.
When the token dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1978-4851-7329.description:
Animate Timeless Lotus using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-3817-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2645-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that share a creature type if Staff of Domination is in your graveyard, or five creatures that share a creature type otherwise.
2645-3918-7013.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color
If Staff of Domination is in your graveyard, activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it. Then, skip to step 5.
If Staff of Domination is on the battlefield, activate its third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Trazyn.
Activate Staff of Domination by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3918-7013.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

3305-3817-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

1495-2313-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Conclave Mentor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-2313-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

1029-3291-5028.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least two.
1029-3291-5028.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Karametra's Acolyte.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-3291-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

38-2420-5663.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2420-5663.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Scuzzback Marauders enters the battlefield, Cayth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scuzzback Marauders
Repeat.

3734-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Phyrexian Metamorph on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Phyrexian Metamorph do not have summoning sickness.
3734-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Phyrexian Metamorph.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Phyrexian Metamorph.
Activate Phyrexian Metamorph by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

3259-4885-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-4885-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

372-4284-4344.description:
Cast Lumbering Battlement by paying {4}{W}.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Clone to return from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When Clone enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Lumbering Battlement until Clone leaves the battlefield.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Clone and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Clone leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement returns to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

579-3493-4289.notablePrerequisites: Patrol Signaler does not have summoning sickness.
579-3493-4289.description:
Activate Patrol Signaler by tapping it, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {1}{W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2557-3693-4321-5270.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Samwise triggers, creating four Food artifact tokens.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Walking Ballista to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2626-3693-4986.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Walking Ballista enters and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1099-2506-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
The Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Lightning Crafter.
Resolve the Lightning Crafter trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing the Lightning Crafter token.
The Lightning Crafter token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken LIghtning Crafter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Sling-Gang Lieutenant abilities, causing each opponent to lose infinite life and you to gain infinite life.

568-914.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine artifacts and/or enchantments.
568-914.description:
Cast Capsize for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist for {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of artifacts and enchantments your opponent control.
Activate eight of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
